title: Ashmita Chaliha Wins Maiden BWF World Tour Title at Korea Masters
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Ashmita Chaliha secured her first BWF World Tour title, marking a significant milestone in her career.
summary: Ashmita Chaliha, 26, made a remarkable comeback from a career-threatening injury in 2024 to win the Korea Masters, joining an elite group of Indian women to achieve a Super 300 title.

title: Coach Park Tae-Sang Reaping Rewards of Hard Work in Indian Badminton
indian_angle: This story highlights the crucial role of coach Park Tae-Sang in developing the next generation of Indian badminton stars.
summary: Park Tae-Sang, known for his work with PV Sindhu, is now seeing the fruits of his labor as Indian players achieve success, indicating a strong future for the sport in the country.

title: Ayush Shetty Prepares for Maiden BWF World Championships Challenge
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Ayush Shetty is set to make his debut at the BWF World Championships, representing India on the global stage.
summary: Ayush Shetty will begin his BWF World Championships campaign in New Delhi against China’s Shi Yu Qi, expressing no pressure despite their previous encounters.

title: Final Selection Trials for BWF World Junior Championships 2026 Underway
indian_angle: The selection trials are crucial for identifying India's top junior talent to represent the nation at the upcoming World Junior Championships.
summary: The Badminton Association of India announced the final selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt, including changes to women's doubles pairings.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This camp is vital for preparing India's young talent for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: A coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.
